notes: SEO > Catalog Services' Language filter now also switches the Category column (previously only Name/Description/Status followed it) to that language's translated category, falling back to the raw pricing-sync text if untranslated yet - so the category shown always matches the selected language, same as the name. Also: the Language filter itself (added in 1.31.5) doesn't hide any rows (the catalog has no per-language rows), it switches what Name/Category/Description/Status display, with a Status badge (Source / Translated / Pending / Not queued) showing where each service stands for the selected language. Fixes Landing Category matching being unreliable across languages: match_text is checked ONLY against a service's English and site-default-language category/name, never whatever single language the pricing API's account happens to return. The Catalog pricing sync API server (SEO > Settings) is picked from your existing Free Service Gateway > API Servers list. Adds a public GET /api/services endpoint (restricted to the smm.plus CORS origin) serving the cached retail catalog (price/min/max, synced daily) filtered by an admin-configured landing-page category slug, with optional geo/lang filtering. Also corrects the earlier 1.27.30 update, which broke the Analytics page - this build includes all of 1.28-1.31's analytics/purchase-tracking/Telegram-view-top-up work intact. Requires 'Update database' for two new tables (catalog_services, landing_service_categories).
